statement: Assume: prefixes i.i.d.; t in {0,1} with P(t=1) = w_1 in (0,1); r | t ~ F_t on [0,1]; K | (r,t) ~ Bin(m, r) with m >= 4; y = beta_0 + beta_1 r + beta_2 r^2 + b t + eta with E[eta | r,t,K] = 0 and E[eta^2 | r,t,K] = sigma^2(r); x = (1, r, r^2), Q_xx = E[x x'] invertible and D = w_1 - q' Q_xx^{-1} q > 0 with q = E[t x]. Then sqrt(n)(b_hat - b) is asymptotically normal with variance D^{-2} E[phi^2], where phi = psi_t - gamma' psi_x, gamma = Q_xx^{-1} q, psi = m_i - M_i beta the estimating-function vector at the truth, and in particular the variance depends on F_t only through moments of order <= 8. premises: As stated; standard M-estimation regularity (finite moments are automatic on [0,1]).
